AddTripRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/operations/driver/trips/{tripId}`. The driver is the session's and
the trip is added on today in Italy, so the body names neither. The customer and the leading vehicle
are required; the trailer and the two locations are optional.

customerId.description: The customer the trip is done for.

deliveryLocationId.description: The delivery location; `null` when not named.

pickupLocationId.description: The pickup location; `null` when not named.

start.description: `true` to start the trip now, in the same act that adds it.

BillingLevel.description:
How finely the rates of a Contract are set, and so which locations a trip must
name (PRD §5.4).

ChangeContractFromDateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{customerId}/contracts/{contractId}/change-from-date`:
the members of UpdateContractRequest (the terms as written on the
page, the `Version` the client read) plus the day the changed terms start. The validity
as written is cut at `ChangeFrom`.

CheckTripAnswersResponse.description:
Which answers of a trip still hold. An answer that was not sent is `true`: there is nothing to
empty.

customer.description: The customer is active and has a contract in force today.

delivery.description: The delivery location is active and accepted by the contract in force.

pickup.description: The pickup location is active and accepted by the contract in force.

trailer.description: The trailer is active, a trailer, and fits the leading vehicle.

vehicle.description: The leading vehicle is active and a tractor or a standalone vehicle.

ContractDto.description: A contract as the API returns it.

customerId.description: The customer the contract belongs to.

dayPrice.description: The day price; `null` when the contract has no rate.

locationRates.description: The location rates, ordered by pickup then delivery location; empty when the contract has none.

minimumAmount.description: The minimum amount M; `null` unless the rule has one.

minimumOveragePrice.description: The overage price Y; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

oneOf.description: The kind of minimum rule; `null` when the contract has no rate.

minimumThreshold.description: The threshold X; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

nightCallFee.description: The night call fee; `null` without the night surcharge or a rate.

nightPrice.description: The night price; `null` without the night surcharge or a rate.

requiredDocuments.description: The required documents, in canonical order.

status.description: Where today, in Italian time, falls against the validity; derived, never stored.

validTo.description: Last day of the validity, or `null` when the contract is open.

vehicleRates.description: The vehicle rates, ordered by license plate; empty when the contract has none.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this contract.

ContractLocationRateDto.description:
A location rate of a contract as the API returns it, with the locations it is for. A side the
billing level does not use is `null`.

oneOf.description: The delivery location; `null` when the billing level does not use it.

minimumAmount.description: The minimum amount M; `null` unless the rule has one.

minimumOveragePrice.description: The overage price Y; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

minimumThreshold.description: The threshold X; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

nightCallFee.description: The night call fee; `null` without the night surcharge.

nightPrice.description: The night price; `null` without the night surcharge.

oneOf.description: The pickup location; `null` when the billing level does not use it.

ContractLocationRateRequest.description:
One location rate of a contract request: the pickup and the delivery location the billing level
uses and the seven rate members, as sent. Every member is optional here so that a missing or
misplaced value is reported by ContractRequestValidation on its own key,
`LocationRates[i].Member`.

ContractStatus.description:
Where a day falls against the validity of a Contract; derived, never stored
(PRD §5.4).

ContractVehicleRateDto.description:
A vehicle rate of a contract as the API returns it, with the vehicle and the locations it is for. A
side the billing level does not use is `null`.

oneOf.description: The delivery location; `null` when the billing level does not use it.

minimumAmount.description: The minimum amount M; `null` unless the rule has one.

minimumOveragePrice.description: The overage price Y; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

minimumThreshold.description: The threshold X; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

nightCallFee.description: The night call fee; `null` without the night surcharge.

nightPrice.description: The night price; `null` without the night surcharge.

oneOf.description: The pickup location; `null` when the billing level does not use it.

vehicleId.description: The vehicle the rate is for.

vehicleStatus.description: The vehicle's status: a decommissioned vehicle keeps its vehicle rate.

ContractVehicleRateRequest.description:
One vehicle rate of a contract request: the vehicle, the pickup and the delivery location the billing
level uses (none on a flat-rate contract) and the seven rate members, as sent. Every
member is optional here so that a missing or misplaced value is reported by
ContractRequestValidation on its own key, `VehicleRates[i].Member`.

CreateContractRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{customerId}/contracts` (PRD §5.4, RF-16).
Every member but the end of the validity, the seven rate members, the vehicle rates and the
location rates is required; an empty set of documents is valid and duplicates collapse. The
rate members are required for a flat-rate contract (the night ones with the night surcharge,
the minimum ones as its rule asks) and must be absent for any other billing level. The location
rates are required, at least one, for any other billing level and must be absent for a flat-rate
contract. A vehicle rate carries no location on a flat-rate contract; on any other level it names
the pickup and delivery location the level uses, of one of the location rates. An absent list is
an empty one.

CreateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers` (PRD §4, RF-15). Only the company name is
required; an empty VAT number, tax code or address is stored as none. The company name and the
address are measured once trimmed, as the aggregate stores them, so their length is checked in
`Validate` rather than with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateCustomerResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/customers` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

taxCode.description: The tax code in normal form, or `null`.

vatNumber.description: The VAT number in normal form, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this customer.

CreateDriverRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/drivers` (PRD §6.5, RF-24). First and last name are
required; an empty phone number is stored as none and a missing `UserId` means a driver
without an account. Lengths and the phone format are checked in `Validate`, measured once
trimmed as the aggregate stores them.

CreateLocationRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/locations` (PRD §5.1, RF-23). The name and the
municipality are required; an empty address is stored as none. All three are measured once
trimmed, as the aggregate stores them, so their length is checked in `Validate` rather than
with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateLocationResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/locations` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this location.

CreateUserResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/identity/users` request.

role.description: The functional role assigned to the user.

status.description: The initial lifecycle status (always UserStatus.Active on creation).

CreateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles` (PRD RF-26, RF-27). The description is
measured once trimmed, as the aggregate stores it, so its length is checked in
`Validate` rather than with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateVehicleResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/vehicles` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

requiresTrailer.description: Whether a trip led by this vehicle must name a trailer.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this vehicle.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

vatNumber.description: The VAT number in normal form, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this customer.

CustomerStatus.description: Whether a Customer can be chosen for new trips and contracts (PRD §4, RF-15).

DeactivateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{id}/deactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the customer has changed since.

DeactivateDriverRequest.description:

DeactivateLocationRequest.description:

The Identity user account a driver is linked to, read from Identity at the time of the request

username.description: Normalised login name of the account.

DriverListItemDto.description: A driver as the API returns it (PRD §6.5, RF-24).

oneOf.description: The linked user account, or `null` when the driver has no access.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

phone.description: The phone number as typed, trimmed, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this driver.

DriverStatus.description:
Whether a Driver can be chosen for new trips and can use the driver area
(PRD §6.5, RF-24, RF-25).

EnableUserRequest.description:

EndTripRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/operations/driver/trips/{tripId}/end`. The time absent ends the trip
now; the measure the contract asks for is given, the other is not.

kilograms.description: The kilograms carried, for a trip measured by weight.

kilometres.description: The kilometres driven, for a trip measured by distance.

time.description: The time the trip ended; `null` to end it now.

GetCurrentUserResponse.description: The signed-in user as the database knows it now.

driverId.description: The linked Registry driver for a `Driver` user; null when unlinked or for any other role.

role.description: The user's role, serialised by name.

GetDriverHomeResponse.description:
What the driver home shows: the driver's name, the trip in progress, the planned trips and the trips the
driver can repeat.

oneOf.description: The trip in progress; `null` when there is none.

planned.description: The planned trips that have not expired, in the order they were added.

repeatableTrips.description:
Every repeatable trip of the driver, built from ended trips, the one ended
            last first; the page shows the first four and offers the rest.

GetNewTripResponse.description: What "Nuovo viaggio" proposes when it opens.

hasTripInProgress.description: Whether the driver has a trip in progress.

oneOf.description:
The trailer of that trip, when the vehicle and the trailer still hold; `null`
            otherwise. A trailer that is missing is not judged: a tractor that now requires one is proposed
            without it.

The leading vehicle of the driver's most recent trip started today, when it still
            holds; `null` otherwise.

GetTripResponse.description: One trip of the driver and what its page needs besides it.

daysToExpiry.description:
For a planned trip, 7 on the day it was added and 0 on its last day;
            `null` otherwise.

oneOf.description:
For a trip in progress, what ending it asks of the driver, by the contract of the
            trip day; `null` for any other trip.

proposedStart.description:
For a planned trip, the end time of the driver's latest trip ended today,
            proposed as the start time; `null` when none ended today and for any other trip.

InProgressTripDto.description: A trip in progress and what its end asks.

endAsks.description: What ending it asks of the driver, by the contract of the trip day.

ListTripCustomersResponse.description: The customers offered today, split as the question shows them.

others.description: The other customers, in the order the Registry gives them (by company name).

recent.description:
The customers of the driver's latest trips, most recent first, five at most;
            empty when a search text is given.

RepeatableTripDto.description:
What a past trip offers to do again: customer, locations, leading vehicle and trailer, named as the
registry names them now (a decommissioned vehicle keeps its name).

oneOf.description: The delivery location; `null` when the trip named none.
The pickup location; `null` when the trip named none.
The trailer; `null` when the trip had none.

RequiredDocument.description:
A document a Contract asks for. The declaration order is the canonical order of
a set of required documents (PRD §5.4).

SimulatePriceRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/contracts/simulation`: the terms of a contract as
written on the page, saved or not, and a sample trip. The billing level, the rate members, the vehicle
rates and the location rates follow the contract requests; `StartTime` and `EndTime` are
`HH:mm`. The end is for a trip by hour
only, `Kilograms` for a trip by weight only and `Kilometres` for a trip by distance only;
the quantities are whole numbers, read as numbers so that a fraction is reported on its own member.
`VehicleId` is the trip's vehicle: `null`, or a vehicle without a vehicle rate on the trip's
location or pair, uses the contract's rate on a flat-rate contract and the rate of the location or pair
on a location level. `PickupLocationId` and `DeliveryLocationId` are the
trip's locations: each is required when the billing level uses it, refused when it does not, and must
have a rate among the written location rates.

SimulatedNightBandDto.description: The night band a simulation classified the trip with.

StartTripRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/operations/driver/trips/{tripId}/start`. Both members absent start the
trip now; otherwise both are given, as the day and time the driver typed.

day.description: The day the trip started; `null` to start it now.

time.description: The time the trip started; `null` to start it now.

TimeBand.description: Whether a trip starts in the night band.

TripCustomerDto.description: A customer the driver can choose for a trip.

vatNumber.description: The VAT number; `null` when the customer has none.

TripDto.description:
A trip in any state, as the driver app receives it: what was answered, named as the registry names it
now, and the times and measures once they exist. It carries no price.

day.description: The day the trip started; `null` while it is planned.

oneOf.description: The delivery location; `null` when none was named.

end.description: The end time; `null` until it is ended.

kilograms.description: The kilograms carried; `null` unless the trip was measured by weight.

kilometres.description: The kilometres driven; `null` unless the trip was measured by distance.

number.description: The trip number; `null` until it is ended.

oneOf.description: The pickup location; `null` when none was named.

start.description: The start time; `null` while it is planned.

TripEndAsks.description: What the end of a trip still asks of the driver. It names the measure, never the way the contract prices.

TripLocationDto.description: A location the driver can pick up from or deliver to.

TripLocationsAsked.description: Which locations a trip for a customer on a day must name.

TripPlaceDto.description: A location, or a pair, a contract has a rate for. Only the sides the contract asks for are set.

oneOf.description: The delivery location; `null` when the contract does not ask for it.
The pickup location; `null` when the contract does not ask for it.

TripQuestionsDto.description: What the contract of a customer today asks of the driver, never its terms.

oneOf.description:
The place of the driver's latest trip for the customer, when the contract
            still offers it; `null` otherwise.

locationsAsked.description: Which locations the contract asks for.

places.description: The locations or pairs the contract offers; empty when it asks for none.

TripState.description: Where a trip is, read from its times alone: it is never stored.

TripVehicleDto.description: A vehicle the driver can choose for a trip.

description.description: The description, for example make and model.

kind.description: Whether it is a tractor, a standalone vehicle or a trailer.

requiresTrailer.description: Whether a tractor must be chosen together with a trailer.

TripVehicleKind.description: What a vehicle is, for the role it can take in a trip.

UpdateContractRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/customers/{customerId}/contracts/{contractId}`
(PRD §5.4, RF-16): the terms of the contract, with its rate members as in
CreateContractRequest, plus the `Version` the client read; the
save is refused when the contract has changed since.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/customers/{id}` (PRD §4, RF-15). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the customer has changed since.

UpdateDriverRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/drivers/{id}` (PRD §6.5, RF-24). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the driver has changed since. A missing
`UserId` removes the account link.

UpdateLocationRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/locations/{id}` (PRD §5.1, RF-23). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the location has changed since.

UpdateNightBandRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/night-band`. `Start` and `End` are `HH:mm`;
`Version` is the version the client read, and the save is refused when the band has changed since.

UpdateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/vehicles/{id}` (PRD RF-26, RF-27). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

UserListItemDto.description: A single item in the paginated list of users.

UserRole.description:
Functional role assigned to a User. Drives both back-office
authorization policies and the strict driver/back-office data boundary
(drivers must never see pricing — see `docs/context.md` §1).

UserStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a User. A disabled user cannot log in and
cannot change password; the back office enables/disables users via dedicated
commands (per RNF-02 revocation requirement).

VehicleStatus.description: Whether a Vehicle can be chosen for new trips (PRD §6.6, RF-29).

VehicleType.description: What role a Vehicle can play in a trip (PRD §5.2, RF-26).

1-based page number. Optional on the wire; values below 1 are coerced to 1
on the setter. Read via int PagedRequest.EffectivePage to get the resolved value
(defaulting to int PagedRequest.DefaultPage when null).
parameters.name: page

parameters.description:
Page size between 1 and int PagedRequest.MaxPageSize. Optional on the wire;
non-positive values are coerced to int PagedRequest.DefaultPageSize, values
greater than int PagedRequest.MaxPageSize are clamped to int PagedRequest.MaxPageSize.
Read via int PagedRequest.EffectivePageSize to get the resolved value
(defaulting to int PagedRequest.DefaultPageSize when null).
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description:
Name of the column to sort by. Optional; handlers fall back to a default
safe column when this is null or not in their whitelist.
parameters.name: sortColumn

parameters.description:
Sort direction. Optional on the wire; readers should use
bool PagedRequest.IsAscending which resolves null to
SortDirection.Ascending.
parameters.name: sortDirection

parameters.description:
The driver being edited: when it has an account, that account is offered too, even when
disabled. When null, only the free enabled driver accounts are returned.
parameters.name: driverId

parameters.description:
